manuscript.title: Catalan's constant is irrational

proof_location.summary: Contradicts prime-scale finite-place lower and real-place upper determinant bounds under the hypothesis that G is rational.

downstream_not_in_selected_comparator: The two-cusped hyperbolic three-manifold minimum volume is irrational
Whitehead-link and (-2,3,8)-pretzel-link complement volumes are irrational
Arithmetic hyperbolic three-orbifold volumes over Q(i) are irrational

formalization.theorem_statement: Irrational (∑' j : ℕ, (-1 : ℝ) ^ j / ((2 * j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2)

crosswalk.qualification: This is an identifiable additional upstream Lean formalization and Comparator, not an absent proof. Do not treat it as one of WP01's 200 indexed replay passes.

producer_review.principal_claim: The manuscript and actual Lean theorem each assert irrationality of the same explicitly written alternating series, without added hypotheses.
producer_review.scope_of_comparison: Theorem 1.1 only; the selected Comparator does not test the manuscript's hyperbolic-volume applications.
producer_review.proof_scope: The proof file imports finite-place, prime-nonvanishing and real-determinant lemmas; their manuscript-level equivalence and the full imported dependency graph were not adjudicated.
producer_review.error_module_interpretation: ManuscriptCaseOneX4SubstitutionError is an error-bound theorem name, not by itself a finding that the manuscript is false.

findings: The displayed theorem is not a full definition/model-bridge proof.
The challenge's sorry is an intended placeholder, not evidence of a sorry in the solution.
The selected theorem cannot be used to declare the geometric consequences formalized.
No WP01 200-row Comparator result can be inherited merely because an additional challenge exists.
Any full-semantic-match or certification claim would exceed the present evidence.
